required_audit_coverage.name: required_audit_coverage
required_audit_coverage.detail: report covers all 44 Required Audit items with substantive aligned answers
required_audit_items: Is decision_meta valid JSON with schema_version=1?
Is status APPROVED and mainline project_governance?
Is reverse-agent-iteration@v2 active?
Is task_packet treated as background only?
Is the previous manual audit outcome correctly recorded as REWORK_REQUIRED?
Is this round limited to Required Audit final-evidence truth and closeout ordering?
Is the previous state-manifest freshness implementation preserved rather than duplicated?
Which stale digest/size claims were present in the previous report?
Which future-tense completion claims were present in the previous report?
Why did the previous final-check pass despite those stale or future-tense report claims?
Does an accepted report now reject future-tense completion claims in Evidence and Answer fields?
Does an accepted report now reject a statement claiming that no future-tense claims exist when such claims are present?
If a Required Audit answer explicitly claims an exact SHA-256, is the full 64-character value required?
If a Required Audit answer explicitly claims an exact SHA-256, is it checked against the live file or current manifest entry?
If a Required Audit answer explicitly claims size_bytes, is it checked against the live file or current manifest entry?
Are abbreviated digest prefixes prevented from being presented as exact equality evidence?
Does the final report avoid embedding its own SHA-256?
Does the final report avoid embedding mutable final-gate or report-summary digests that change after report finalization?
Is a structured report_finalization block present in both report aliases?
Does report_finalization match the current decision_id, round_id, and report_id?
Does report_finalization identify project_state/gates/run_closeout_result.json as its closeout evidence source?
Does report_finalization contain the full live run_closeout_result SHA-256?
Does report_finalization match the live run_closeout generated_at and closeout_status?
Does report_finalization match the embedded close_round_result.close_status?
Was the report finalized after the current run-closeout evidence existed?
Was the final explicit close-round/archive refresh performed after report finalization?
Does the archived report match the final live report?
Do execution_report.md and codex_execution_report.md agree on summary fields and report_finalization?
Does pytest_result.txt match the current decision, round, and report?
Does pytest_result.txt record the exact pytest command and exit code 0?
Does command_plan.json exist, pass, and explicitly cover pytest, report-summary, execution-log, final-check, run-closeout, and close-round?
Were any omitted or unauthorized commands executed?
Does execution_log.json agree with pytest_result.txt, command_plan.json, and run-closeout evidence?
Does report_summary_synthesis.json match the final reports?
Does final_gate_result.json include and pass Required Audit future-claim and live-claim checks?
Does final_gate_result.json preserve state_manifest_freshness=PASS?
Does current_context_packet.json match the current decision and round after post-final sync?
Does post_final_evidence_sync_result.json report PASSED with context_generated_after_final_gate=true?
Does run_closeout_result.json report PASSED?
Does the final close-round result report CLOSED?
Does the new round_manifest exist and match final live reports, pytest, decision, and closeout state?
Were all forbidden paths left untouched?
Were no runner, Web, workflow, model API, database, cleanup, reverse-tool, or sample-solving capabilities used?
Does the final Required Audit body contain only current observed evidence and no placeholder, generic, contradictory, or future-tense completion answers?
